title: Saudi Arabian Juicy Jumbo Lettuce Bowl
description: A refreshing, fermented, and tender post-workout dish that combines the flavors of Saudi Arabia with the crunch of fresh lettuce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, bhuna spice mix, Himalayan salt, and black pepper until smooth.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add graham rice and toast for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add roasted chickpeas and lime juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Toss the lettuce with the rice and chickpea mixture, ensuring the greens are evenly coated.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, fermented pickle slices, and serve immediately.
Chill the yogurt dressing in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Prepare the roasted chickpeas by tossing 1/2 cup of chickpeas with olive oil, salt, and your choice of spices and roasting in a 400°F oven for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the graham rice according to package instructions. Chill in the refrigerator before using.
Prepare the bhuna spice mix according to the recipe or store-bought instructions.
Make the yogurt dressing by whisking together yogurt, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl until smooth.
Toss the lettuce in a bowl with a pinch of salt and your choice of spices to bring out the flavors.
Chop the fresh cilantro and set aside for garnish.
Cut the fermented pickle slices into wedges and set aside for garnish.
Slice the red cabbage and Turkish red pepper into thin strips and set aside for garnish.
Prepare the roasted chickpeas by rinsing 1 cup of chickpeas, patting dry with a paper towel, and tossing with olive oil, salt, and your choice of spices in a bowl until evenly coated.
Roast the chickpeas in a 400°F oven for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crispy and golden brown.
